chapter_title: The High School Entrance Exam Begins

segments.title: The High School Entrance Exam Begins
segments.content:
June 14th, Saturday, sunny.

At six o'clock in the morning, Li Luo got out of bed, washed up, changed into his school uniform, and went to the balcony to push open the window.

He was greeted by the cool morning breeze.

Li Luo closed his eyes, recalling last night's gains. His heart felt remarkably steady, yet there was a flicker of excitement.

"Up so early?" In the living room, Li Guohong, who had just gotten up to make breakfast, was surprised to see Li Luo on the balcony. "Did you get enough sleep?"

"Dad, I'm full of energy right now." Li Luo turned and walked back into the living room, grinning. "I feel like I could even get into Fuyi High."

"..." On any other day, Li Guohong would have probably rolled his eyes at him, but today was the day of the entrance exam. He could only smile, patting his son's shoulder a few times. "Good, keep up that spirit!"

Having confidence was always a good thing.

After washing up, Li Guohong started making breakfast.

Li Luo, on the other hand, returned to his bedroom, took out a scratchpad, and scribbled on it, once again confirming the test questions he had already conquered last night.

Taking advantage of the mental clarity from just waking up, he also opened the memory palace deep in his mind to briefly review the science and English exam papers for tomorrow.

Time passed quickly.

In the blink of an eye, it was past seven in the morning.

Lin Xiuhong had also woken up and was in the kitchen helping with breakfast.

After she finished, she shouted towards the bedroom, "Li Luo! Go next door and ask Xixi to come over for breakfast."

"Got it," Li Luo answered. He put down his pen, stood up, and walked out the door.

Arriving at the entrance to Room 402 across the hall, Li Luo felt along the side of the couplets pasted by the door and retrieved a key wedged behind them.

But Li Luo didn't open the door directly. He first knocked hard on Ying Chanxi's door a few times before inserting the key.

The familiar layout of the living room unfolded before his eyes.

Awakened by the knocking, a sleepy-eyed Ying Chanxi opened her bedroom door. She was wearing a cute panda pajama set and rubbing her eyes as she walked out.

Having just woken up, Ying Chanxi still looked dazed. Her slightly baby-fatted, goose-egg-shaped face looked all the more adorable and supple.

"My mom is calling you over for breakfast."

"Oh..." Ying Chanxi nodded, covering her mouth as she yawned. She walked past Li Luo towards the bathroom. "Let me wash my face first."

"I'll head back then."

"Wait." Ying Chanxi stopped at the bathroom door and turned to Li Luo. "There's a set of school clothes on the balcony, can you help me get them?"

"Sure."

"And socks, the white ones."

"Got it."

Li Luo went to the balcony, reached out to take down the clean, dry short-sleeved school uniform shirt and pants, and grabbed a pair of white socks as well.

Ying Chanxi went into the bathroom. After a quick brush of her teeth and a wash of her face, she didn't need to apply any skincare products. At fifteen, her age was the most perfect form of maintenance. A simple splash of cold water was enough to make her face look so pink and tender it seemed you could squeeze water from it.

"Come over when you're dressed," Li Luo said, tossing the clothes onto the sofa before returning to 401.

After washing up, Ying Chanxi took off her pajamas, quickly changed her clothes, and walked towards the apartment across the hall while tying her hair.

...

By the time they finished breakfast, it was already half past seven.

Li Luo packed his school bag, making sure he had everything he needed.

Beside him, Ying Chanxi carefully double-checked it for him before handing the bag over with confidence.

Once everything was ready, the group of four left the house.

Yinjiang District Yucai Middle School was not far from Li Luo's home, just two blocks away.

So Li Guohong didn't drive. The four of them walked all the way, arriving at the school gate in seven or eight minutes.

At this time, the entrance to Yucai Middle School was cordoned off with a yellow warning line by security guards, and the road was bustling with people and traffic.

Test-takers wearing uniforms from various middle schools gathered here, holding their admission tickets and lining up to enter the school gate after being checked by security.

Even though the soul in his body was already 35 years old, being back in this scene still made Li Luo's heart surge, along with a tiny hint of nervousness.

"Teacher Zhang, hello, hello."

Li Guohong saw Li Luo's homeroom teacher and was the first to walk up and greet him.

"Hello, hello." Zhang Wei glanced at Li Luo, then said with a smile, "You must be Li Luo's parent, right?"

"Yes, yes. Li Luo, this kid, has really troubled Teacher Zhang."

"Not at all, not at all. It's my duty."

The parent and teacher exchanged pleasantries.

Li Luo and Ying Chanxi, however, walked over to Zhao Rongjun.

As the only boy in their class to be accepted into Fuyi High through independent recruitment, Zhao Rongjun had been roped into manual labor by the homeroom teacher, helping to distribute admission tickets to their classmates.

Upon seeing Li Luo arrive, Zhao Rongjun fumbled in the bag for a moment before handing Li Luo's admission ticket over.

"Li Luo, did you really go home to review yesterday?" Zhao Rongjun asked with a curious look.

"Yeah." Li Luo blinked, a little puzzled. "What else would I be doing?"

"Ahem..." Zhao Rongjun hadn't expected Li Luo to have such a sudden change of heart, but he still said, "Well, I wish you the best on your exam. Good luck!"

"Of course." Li Luo nodded. "After receiving guidance from our class president, I think I can get into Fuyi High. We'll still be classmates."

"Overconfidence is arrogance." Shao Heqi, who had appeared out of nowhere, suddenly interjected. "I suggest you be more pragmatic. Fuyi High is not something you should be thinking about."

Li Luo glanced at the vice class president, completely unfazed by his words.

He was just boasting a little to people he was close with.

Everyone knew what his actual academic level was. Without the memory palace, he was well aware of his own capabilities.

But beside him, Ying Chanxi patted his shoulder. A bright smile bloomed on her face as she encouraged him, "A person has to have a dream. I believe in you."

"The class president is right." Hearing Ying Chanxi say this, Shao Heqi immediately changed his tune. "Anyway, let's all do our best."

Li Luo looked at Shao Heqi and could only sigh for him. To have the makings of a simp at such a young age was somewhat pathetic.

In his memory, when they graduated from high school, he had heard that Shao Heqi confessed his feelings to Ying Chanxi.

But the result was obvious; Ying Chanxi had rejected him quite bluntly.

"It's about time, you guys should go in first." Zhao Rongjun checked the time. It was almost eight in the morning, so he spoke up.

So Li Luo and Shao Heqi took their admission tickets and queued up to enter the school.

A short while later, the plump, freckled Jin Yuting also came in from the line outside and met them at the entrance of the exam building.

Shao Heqi had nothing to say to Li Luo. It was only when he saw Jin Yuting that he spoke up with a hint of mockery in his tone, "Do you know what Li Luo was saying outside just now?"

"What?" Jin Yuting asked, looking puzzled.

"He said he can get into Fuyi High." Without Ying Chanxi around, Shao Heqi made no effort to hide his snide tone, finding Li Luo utterly ridiculous.

Jin Yuting, who had just arrived, burst out laughing upon hearing this. "No way, Li Luo... even I'm not a hundred percent sure I can get into Fuyi High. How can you just say that?"

Li Luo couldn't be bothered with the two of them. He sat down on the steps nearby and closed his eyes to rest.

Based on vice class president Shao Heqi's usual grades, he was ranked in the top fifty of the school, so getting into Fuyi High was more than guaranteed for him.

But for Jin Yuting, who usually hovered around the top one hundred, getting into Fuyi High was indeed not a sure thing.

Still, it was much better than Li Luo, who perennially ranked beyond three hundredth place.

It was understandable that these two kids looked down on him, and Li Luo really had no mind to argue with them.

Soon, with fifteen minutes left before the exam, the exam rooms were opened. The test-takers entered the classrooms one after another, finding their seats.

Li Luo followed the crowd into the exam room. Sitting in a seat that felt both unfamiliar and a little familiar, he gradually calmed down, a stark contrast to the tense and solemn atmosphere around him.

The proctor stood at the podium, announcing the exam rules and regulations, then held up a sealed envelope from which he pulled out stacks of test papers.

As the start time for the exam approached, the Chinese language papers were distributed. Li Luo took a deep breath, scanning the questions while comparing them with the Chinese paper in his memory palace.

Excellent!

The questions were correct.

Li Luo completely relaxed.

When the exam bell rang, he picked up his pen and began to answer the questions.

...

The Chinese language exam was from 8:30 to 10:30 in the morning.

The June weather in Yuhang City was hot enough to fry an egg on the asphalt roads.

After dropping off their children, many parents left, only to return around ten o'clock.

But many others remained at the school gate without leaving, waiting the entire time for their children to walk out of the exam hall.

"Has Li Luo been asking you to help him review lately?" During the quiet wait, Ying Chanxi curiously asked Zhao Rongjun next to her.

"Huh?" Zhao Rongjun was clearly taken aback, not understanding.

What did she mean, asking him to review?

Whenever Li Luo asked him to play basketball, if he even mentioned reviewing, he'd get a hard time on the court.

"He hasn't?" A look of deep confusion appeared on Ying Chanxi's face as she sized him up suspiciously.

Zhao Rongjun felt a bit spooked by her stare.

Already not good at talking to girls, being watched by Ying Chanxi like this was really making his back sweat.

But relying on years of tacit understanding with Li Luo, Zhao Rongjun managed to keep his composure. "Um... that's a difficult question for me to answer."

He decided to fudge it for now.

But to Ying Chanxi, this reaction was a complete confirmation.

"Is it true?" Ying Chanxi sighed. "You don't have to cover for him. He told me everything yesterday. I thought he'd really given up. Turns out he's been getting secret tutoring from you every day."

Zhao Rongjun: "...?"

He now had absolutely no idea what Ying Chanxi was talking about.

Since when did he give that guy Li Luo secret tutoring?

Did buying him spicy sticks after losing a game count?

But at this moment, Zhao Rongjun knew that silence was the best answer.

And while Ying Chanxi was chatting with Zhao Rongjun, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were also waiting at the school gate, having never left.

Around ten o'clock, as Lin Xiuhong was wiping the fine beads of sweat from her forehead under the shade of a tree, she heard someone call her from behind.

"Isn't that Xiuhong?"

Lin Xiuhong turned her head and saw her cousin, Zhang Xuefen, walking over.

Unlike Lin Xiuhong's simple attire, Zhang Xuefen was dressed in brand-name clothes from head to toe, complete with a necklace, bracelets, and sunglasses. The powder on her face was thicker than the dough Lin Xiuhong kneaded at her breakfast shop.

"Oh, Xuefen." Lin Xiuhong replied simply, with no intention of chatting further.

But Zhang Xuefen clearly didn't plan on just a simple greeting. She walked up to the couple and started making small talk, "Is your Li Luo also taking the exam this year?"

"He is."

"How are his grades usually?" Zhang Xuefen said with a grin. "You were smart since you were little, so your son must be good too, right?"

"They're alright," Lin Xiuhong replied helplessly, not wanting to say more.

"You're just being modest." Zhang Xuefen shook her head. "Our Chunchun is usually just in the top hundred at school, but getting into Fuyi High will be no problem. Your Li Luo can definitely do it too."

Lin Xiuhong took a deep breath, forced a smile, and offered a few perfunctory replies. She was finally saved by the bell signaling the end of the exam. She quickly pulled Li Guohong and headed towards the school gate.

"Your cousin's mouth is the same as always," Li Guohong finally took the chance to complain, making Lin Xiuhong roll her eyes.

"If you and your son could be a little more successful, I wouldn't have to put up with this."

"Alright, alright. Li Luo is about to come out. Let's not talk about this."

After the exam bell rang, the proctors began collecting the papers. A few minutes later, the test-takers started coming out of the building one after another.

Ying Chanxi returned to Lin Xiuhong's side, standing on her toes to peer inside. She soon spotted Li Luo's figure and raised her hand to wave.

"How did it go?" Ying Chanxi asked with a hint of worry.

"In the bag."
